shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving in grey weathered stone
circular/disc motifs (rosettes in A, concentric rings in B)
curvilinear motifs arranged in horizontal zones
paired/repeated symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both are grey stone surfaces bearing shallow, low-relief curvilinear designs organised into roughly horizontal zones, and both include prominent circular/ring motifs (A's rosettes, B's concentric discs). But A is a flat architectural slab with tightly repeated, regular vegetal registers cut with crisp outlining, while B is the curved back of a freestanding volumetric figure with sparse, irregular, boldly simplified motifs — the manner of carving and the object type differ fundamentally.
